Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, power decisions on the battlefield, locate missing children, and more.

The Program
 
In the 20th century, America pioneered mass production. We built the Arsenal of Democracy and won the war. Then we left this mighty Arsenal to rust. Silicon Valley, a product of Heartland work ethic, turned its back on the American worker.

It's time to reawaken the giant.

The Program

lists.content:
We want builders: people who are hungry to learn whatever it takes to succeed and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves and make it happen.

You might be that kind of person if you've taught yourself, or been the local go-to, in one or more of these areas:
  • Software, data, or automation
  • General-purpose programming languages such as Python, C/C++, C# / .NET, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Data science applications such as SQL, MATLAB, Simulink, R, Julia, Excel + VBA
  • Process improvements like instrumenting, automating, or optimizing how things run
  • Prototyping—i.e., testing ideas iteratively instead of waiting for perfect specs

Show us where you've flexed that builder's mindset. That could look like:
  • Formal study in computer science, electrical/mechanical/control systems engineering, physics, applied math, data science, mechatronics, robotics, or a related field
  • Experience solving real problems in settings such as a factory floor, a warehouse or logistics hub, a hospital or clinic, a construction site, field service, energy or utility operations, the military, a small business, or a garage shop, especially if you automated, instrumented, or optimized a process

• 2+ years of hands-on work experience in a technical setting or engaging in on-the-job technical processes
  • Backgrounds in computer science, data science, physics, and engineering domains are preferred, though no formal degree is required.

lists.content:
• Architecting, developing, and maintaining high-performance, scalable backend services that underpin our our operational data and AI systems
  • Maintaining high coding standards through the development of guidelines, active participation in code reviews, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing among your team
  • Building robust APIs for use by front-end developers and interfacing external systems, and collaborating with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
  • Designing efficient data structures and algorithms to manage large-scale and high throughput data

• Different backend languages, including Java, Rust, Python and Go
  • Distributed systems technologies such as Kafka, Cassandra, Elasticsearch and Spark
  • Docker and Kubernetes for containerisation and orchestration
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

• A deep understanding of server-side logic, efficient data handling, and distributed systems
  • Strong focus on creating user-oriented workflows and solutions, crossing product boundaries to deliver cohesive and solid user workflows that ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience
  • Experience building high-quality software in a fast-paced CI/CD development environment
  • Ability to work collaboratively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals and understand how technical decisions impact the people who will use what you're building

The Role
 
Palantir's defense product vertical builds mission-critical products for the modern warfighter. We provide a complete ecosystem where customers can securely integrate and visualize their data, and build sophisticated, full-fledged programs such as common operating pictures, alert-triaging inboxes, and resource allocation planning tools driven by rich-ML models. Our customers use our defense offering to perform rich analyses that drive core operations within their organizations - these programs are relied upon for daily operations in the command centers and battlefronts of militaries across the world.
